achievements.name: Lone Survivor
achievements.description: Win a battle with just your Leader remaining

achievements.name: Snowball Fight
achievements.description: Stack 15 Snow on a single target

achievements.name: Big Hitter
achievements.description: Deal 50 damage in a single hit

achievements.name: Bigger Hitter
achievements.description: Deal 100 damage in a single hit

achievements.name: Tough Nut
achievements.description: Stack 50 Shell on a single target

achievements.name: Ritual
achievements.description: Sacrifice 5 allies in a single battle

achievements.name: Toxic
achievements.description: Stack 20 Shroom on a single target

achievements.name: One Punch
achievements.description: Defeat the Frost Guardian with a Scrappy Sword

achievements.name: Icemaster
achievements.description: Stack 5 Block on a single target

achievements.name: High Roller
achievements.description: Buy 3 Charms from a single shop in one visit - charms get more expensive each time you buy one at the same shop, so save up before spending.

achievements.name: Gnome Friend
achievements.description: Spare the Naked Gnome. On rare occasions (only on your first encounter with it) a Naked Gnome appears at the very start of a boss battle - defeat the boss without killing the gnome to unlock this.

achievements.name: Long Live the King
achievements.description: Survive an attack from King Moko and win the battle

achievements.name: Feed the Beast
achievements.description: Feed the Muncher a Consume item. No starting clan begins with a Consume item, so find one early in a run and feed it to the Muncher (you can abandon the run right after if you are just going for the achievement).

achievements.name: Balloonist
achievements.description: Win a Daily Voyage

achievements.name: Undefeated
achievements.description: Achieve a 3 Win Streak

achievements.name: Sunbringer
achievements.description: Defeat the Heart of the Storm, the game's true final boss. It only appears if you form the Lumin Vase (from Lumin Goop plus the Broken Vase) and have at least 10 points of Storm Bells equipped - Storm Bells start at 5 and increase by 1 each run you complete, so this needs several prior clears before the true fight becomes reachable.

achievements.name: Gnomebringer
achievements.description: Win a run with the Naked Gnome on your team - any ending counts, not just the true one, so recruiting and winning with the Gnome on a normal run is enough.

achievements.name: Hoarder
achievements.description: Have 12 or more cards in your hand at once

achievements.name: Charmless
achievements.description: Win a run without any Charms equipped

achievements.name: Rampage
achievements.description: Stack x10 Frenzy on a single target

achievements.name: Best Friends
achievements.description: Win a run with your pet as your only active Companion

achievements.name: Beastmaster
achievements.description: Defeat a Boss without applying Snow to them

achievements.name: Minimalist
achievements.description: Win a battle without any cards left in your deck

achievements.name: Berry Good
achievements.description: Have 30 or more Health on a single unit

achievements.name: Snowdweller
achievements.description: Win a run with the Snowdweller tribe

achievements.name: Shademancer
achievements.description: Win a run with the Shademancer tribe

achievements.name: Clunkmaster
achievements.description: Win a run with the Clunkmaster tribe
